buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.

3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. XXXX hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 6. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 7. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.

10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (a) Warranty If within a period of 12 Months from the date of inspection/ successful installation of stores a gainst this order, any defect due to design, workmanship or materials is found or stores are defective for a ny other cause whatsoever, the same shall be replaced by you at site free of charge within a period 15 Da ys of the receipt of an intimation from the purchaser unless the purchaser, in his sole discretion agree to th e removal of the defect by you or somebody else at your cost and acceptance thereafter if the stores are t he n found according to the Army requirement. (b) OEM/Authorization certificate is required to be submitted by bidder along with their technical bid. Third party authorization certificate will not be acceptable. (c) The supplier / firm must be Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) / authorized Distributors/ Reseller o f the OEM. The bidders are essentially required to submit a valid authorization certificate (s) from the OEM on all applicable items as mentioned in technical specification, failing which the bid shall be rejected. (d) Undertaking - Undertaking on 100 rupees non judicial stamp paper should be submitted that "the entir e document provided are true" by the bidder and must be uploaded on GeM portal and Stamp paper date after bid publish date. (e) All the documents should be self-attested on bidder company letter head with company stamp and Sig nature & date. (f) Seller should not be bankrupt, blacklisted of any government agency in last three years. Certificates sh ould be provided in stamp paper of Rs 100/- and date of stamp paper should be after bid publish date. (g) Inspection of Stores. The advance sample / consignment will be inspected by a board of officer detailed on behalf of accepting authority. The advance sample consignment will be checked against specification in GeM contract and sample held with consignee. (h) Rejected Stores. In case of entire consignment /part consignment is rejected by the accepting authority , it is responsibility of the supplier to collect the rejected quantity from consignee location within 7 days of i ntimation of rejection. The cost involved will be borne by the supplier. (j) Supply of Rejected Quantity. In case of entire consignment/part consignment is rejected by the acceptin g authority, it is the responsibility of the supplier to supply the rejected quantity within the delivery period. No extension of delivery period will be granted on ground of rejection. (k) No Debarment of Vendors Certificate. (l) Proc from Countries sharing border with India. Bidder from a country sharing land border with india is re qd to submit cert of registration as per GOI/ Min of Fin (Department of Expenditure) OM No F 7/10/2021-PP D dt 23 Feb 2023 regarding amdt to Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 & Order (public proc No 4) N o F7/10/2021-P PD (1) dt 23 Feb 2023 regarding restriction under Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017. (m) Compliance cert of each technical parameter of bids shall be submitted by the bidder in the bid docum e nts with firm official Stamp and singed. (n) Technical Specification. Duly completed by the bidder along with their firm official seal/s tamp and sign ed by the firm as per Appendix ‘A’ of this RFP. (o) Tender Conditions Acceptance Certificate. Duly completed by the bidder along with their firm official se al/stamp and signed by the firm as per Appendix ‘B’ of this RFP. (p) Non Disclosure Certificate asper Appx 'C' of this RFP . .
